companies.description: Wesco International is a global distributor of electrical, electronic and communications products and provider of supply chain services. They sell primarily to businesses across construction, utilities, manufacturing, telecommunications and institutional sectors, offering product distribution plus procurement, inventory management, kitting, logistics and value-added fabrication and repair services. They position themselves as a comprehensive distribution and supply chain partner combining a broad product range with logistics and technical support services.
companies.name: Wesco International, Inc.

companies.description: OGE Energy Corp. operates as a regulated electric utility providing electric generation, transmission, distribution and retail electric service to residential, commercial and industrial customers, and sells wholesale power. They market themselves as a provider focused on reliable energy delivery and grid infrastructure investment while also engaging in energy-related investments and customer energy programs.
companies.name: OGE Energy Corp.

companies.description: Aubrey Silvey Enterprises, Inc. is a company that specializes in providing comprehensive services to the electrical substation industry. Their offerings include substation construction, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, power equipment services, and testing services. Their typical customers include public and private utilities, municipalities, co-generation, and industrial customers. They position themselves as a leading single-source supplier in the industry, emphasizing their small-town values and customer-conscious approach. They also pride themselves on being an employee-owned organization, which they believe differentiates them from others in the industry.
companies.name: Aubrey Silvey Enterprises, Inc.

companies.description: Beacon Global Strategies provides strategic advisory services to business and organizational clients in areas related to national security, defense and aerospace, global technology policy, and geopolitical risk. They offer tailored policy and business-development strategies, risk analysis, strategic communications, and transaction support, and position themselves as a bipartisan advisory firm with decades of public- and private-sector experience.
companies.name: Beacon Global Strategies

companies.description: Vested provides a methodology, training, and advisory services to help organizations structure collaborative, outcome-focused outsourcing and service partnerships. They target enterprise clients and procurement/operations teams and emphasize the Vested Five Rules and supporting courses, case studies, and publications as tools to produce collaborative agreements that create new value.
companies.name: Vested
